questions.question: Which country recently joined the OPEC+ group of oil-producing nations ahead of the UN Climate Summit 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Brazil has joined OPEC+, a coalition of oil-exporting nations, just months before hosting the UN Climate Summit (COP30) in November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **OPEC+ consists of 12 OPEC members and 10 non-OPEC oil-producing nations, including Russia, the largest non-OPEC participant.**
 
• Brazil, the world’s seventh-largest oil producer, pumps about 4.3 million barrels per day.
 
• While Brazil will take part in OPEC+ discussions, it will not have binding obligations such as production cuts.
 
• The decision to join OPEC+ has sparked debate, as Brazil is also hosting the UN Climate Summit (COP30), which aims to reduce fossil fuel consumption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• OPEC+ (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries Plus)__

 __
 
• Formed to regulate oil production and stabilize global oil markets.
 
• Includes 12 OPEC members and 10 additional oil-producing countries.
 
• Saudi Arabia is OPEC’s largest oil producer, while Russia leads the non-OPEC members.
 
 
 
• OPEC__
 
• 
 __
 
• Headquarters of OPEC: Vienna, Austria.
 
• Secretary General: Haitham al-Ghais.
 
• It was founded in 1960.
 
 
 
• Brazil’s Energy and Environmental Policies__
 __
 
• Brazil’s crude oil became its top export product in 2024, surpassing soy.
 
• President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has promoted economic growth through oil revenue while also working to curb Amazon deforestation.
 
 
 
• UN Climate Summit (COP30)__
 
 
• The annual conference focused on global efforts to combat climate change.
 
• Brazil will host COP30 in November 2025, increasing scrutiny of its fossil fuel policies.
 
• Environmental groups have criticized Brazil’s plans for exploratory drilling near the Amazon.

questions.question: Which country became the first in Latin America to exit China's Belt and Road Initiative in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Panama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Panama became the first Latin American country to exit China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) in 2025, signaling a shift in its geopolitical alliances.
 
• The Belt and Road Initiative, launched by China in 2013, is a global infrastructure development strategy aimed at increasing economic and trade connectivity.
 
• Panama had initially joined the BRI in 2017, under the presidency of Juan Carlos Varela, to boost trade and investment ties with China.
 
• Panama's decision to exit the BRI aligns with its efforts to diversify its trade partnerships and reduce dependence on China amid global geopolitical tensions.
 
• The withdrawal has sparked discussions on the long-term sustainability and geopolitical implications of the BRI in Latin America.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Belt and Road Initiative (BRI):**

 
 
• The BRI is a global development strategy initiated by China to invest in infrastructure projects such as roads, railways, and ports in over 140 countries.
 
• It aims to improve trade routes and foster economic integration across Asia, Europe, Africa, and Latin America.
 
 
 
• **Panama's Geopolitical Position:**
 
 
• Panama holds a strategic location due to the Panama Canal, a critical waterway connecting the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
 
• Its geopolitical decisions have significant implications for global trade and security dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Impact of BRI Withdrawal:**
 
 
• Panama's exit from the BRI may influence other Latin American countries to reconsider their participation in the initiative.
 
• It highlights concerns over debt sustainability and the strategic autonomy of participating nations.
 
 
 
• **Alternative Partnerships:**
 
 
• Panama is exploring stronger economic ties with the United States and European Union to balance its trade relations.
 
• These partnerships aim to provide an alternative to Chinese investments and infrastructure projects.

questions.question: What is the name of Israel's military operation against Iran?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Rising Lion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Israel takes name of Iran operation from Bible verse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Israel** has launched a **military operation** against **Iran**, targeting **nuclear facilities**, **ballistic missile factories**, and **military commanders**.

 
 
• 
 
The operation is named **“Rising Lion”**, inspired by a **biblical verse** symbolizing strength and victory.

 
 
• 
 
The name comes from **Numbers 23:24**, which describes **Israel rising like a lion**, victorious and relentless.

 
 
• 
 
The verse is part of **Balaam’s first oracle**, a prophecy by a **non-Israelite diviner**, emphasizing **Israel’s future power** and military might.

questions.question: Which country is home to the Tianshan Shengli Tunnel, the world’s longest expressway tunnel?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Tianshan Shengli Tunnel, the world's longest expressway tunnel, is located in Xinjiang, China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The tunnel, at 22.13 kilometers, is located in the Tianshan Mountains in Xinjiang, China.**
 
• It will significantly reduce the travel time between southern and northern Xinjiang.
 
• The tunnel is part of the Urumqi-Yuli Expressway and will help reduce travel from 7 hours to 3 hours.
 
• China invested in the tunnel to overcome the region's geographical challenges and boost transportation efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tianshan Mountains__

 __
 
• The Tianshan Mountains are located in Xinjiang, China, and are known for their extreme altitudes.
 
• The mountain range stretches for more than 2,500 kilometers across Central Asia.
 
 
 
• Urumqi-Yuli Expressway__
 
 
• This expressway connects Urumqi in northern Xinjiang to Yuli County in the south, facilitating regional trade and travel.
 
• The project is expected to be completed and fully operational by 2025.

questions.question: _____________ built a 3D-printed train station in six hours.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Japan built a 3D-printed train station in six hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Location and Significance:**

 
 
• 
 
The new 3D-printed train station is in **Arida**, Japan.

 
 
• 
 
The station is named **Hatsushima** and replaces a wooden station from **1948**.

 
 
• 
 
It serves about **530 riders** a day.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Construction Details:**

 
 
• 
 
The parts were **3D-printed** in **Kumamoto Prefecture** (southern Japan).

 
 
• 
 
The printing process took **seven days**.

 
 
• 
 
After printing, the parts were transported over **804 km** to the station.

 
 
• 
 
The station's components were **assembled on-site in under six hours**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Technological and Workforce Context:**

 
 
• 
 
Japan's population is ageing, and the workforce is shrinking.

 
 
• 
 
The new 3D-printed station aims to address the challenge of maintaining infrastructure in **remote locations** with fewer workers.

 
 
• 
 
It was constructed with the aim of using **new technology** to support less manpower.

questions.question: Which country declared a 60-day national emergency due to wildfires, water shortages, and drought?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ecuador**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Ecuador declared a **national emergency** due to a combination of **forest fires, water shortages**, and **drought** affecting the country, particularly the **Azuay** and **Loja** provinces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Emergency Details**: The state of emergency, approved by the **Environment Ministry**, will last for **60 days** and aims to free up resources to combat the crisis. It includes deploying **eight firefighting helicopters**, three of which were sent by **Peru** and **Italy**.
 
• **Forest Fires**: The fires have already consumed **40,000 hectares** of crops and killed over **44,000 farm animals**. Ecuador has reported **5,100 forest fires** between January and November 2024, resulting in **six fatalities** and **45 injuries**.
 
• **Drought and Water Shortage**: Ecuador is facing its **worst drought in six decades**, with low water levels affecting hydroelectric plants that cover **70% of the country’s electricity demand**. As a result, electricity rationing has been extended to **14 hours per day**.

questions.question: Which African country became the first to sign the Country Partnership Framework (CPF) with ISA?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Mauritius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mauritius becomes first African country to sign ISA’s Country Partnership Framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Mauritius** is the **first African country** to sign the **Country Partnership Framework (CPF)** with **ISA**.

 
 
• 
 
**Globally**, it is the **fourth country** to sign the CPF:

 
 
• 
 
After **Bangladesh**, **Bhutan**, and **Cuba**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The CPF provides a **structured approach** for collaboration between **ISA** and member countries on **solar energy initiatives**, aligned with national goals.

 
 
• 
 
**ISA** (International Solar Alliance) is a **treaty-based intergovernmental organization**.

 
 
• 
 
**Founded in 2015** by **India and France**.

 
 
• 
 
Objective: To **promote solar energy** as a solution for **energy access and climate change**.

 
 
• 
 
Target: To **mobilize USD 1 trillion** in **solar investments by 2030**.

questions.question: Which country will ban children under 16 from creating YouTube accounts?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• YouTube to be banned for kids under 16 in Australia very soon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Australia** will **ban children under 16** from creating **YouTube accounts** starting **December**.

 
 
• 
 
This is part of **world-first social media restrictions** by the country.

 
 
• 
 
The **ban already applies** to **TikTok**, **Snapchat**, **Instagram**, **Facebook**, and **X (formerly Twitter)**.

 
 
• 
 
The move follows recommendations from the **eSafety Commissioner**.

 
 
• 
 
Though YouTube is mainly a **video platform**, it exposes children to risks like **harmful content**, **cyberbullying**, and **mental health issues**.

 
 
• 
 
Under the new rule, children under 16 can still **watch YouTube** but **can’t post**, **comment**, or get **personalised recommendations**.
